scope: Atlas Expert Mathematics Source Resolution Sprint. Resolve a mathematics expert source suitable for Atlas. No ingestion, no full-dataset download, no Atlas data modification.
method: Measured verification only. Each candidate checked via: (1) Hugging Face API dataset metadata (license tag, gated/private/disabled flags, splits), (2) official README/license file fetch where applicable, (3) GitHub API + LICENSE file fetch for canonical repos, (4) streaming schema probe of 3 rows per candidate to confirm field structure. No license is invented; entries marked UNKNOWN where a fact could not be confirmed.
verification_policy: license status VERIFIED only when the license tag was read from the official HF card/README or the official LICENSE file was fetched. PARTIAL when custom license terms were inspected but are non-SPDX. UNKNOWN when no authoritative source was reachable.

summary.primary_recommendation: OpenMathInstruct-2 (nvidia/OpenMathInstruct-2, CC-BY-4.0, public) resolves the previously BLOCKED expert-math-002 with a permissive, redistribution-friendly license. NuminaMath-CoT (Apache-2.0) is the strongest secondary candidate for E2/E3 olympiad reasoning. Both verified by HF API metadata + 3-row schema probes.
